acceptance_criteria:
# Goals

- Qualify mini close adapters against the canonical evidence-admission repair (mini #81; depends on full-pack prometheus-skill-system#219)
- A1: select the repaired shared-runtime artifact and record exact source and binary identity
- A2: in an isolated temporary project, wrong phase/project, missing source hashes and empty required observation cases all refuse without CLOSED through both direct canonical close and the real Node-wrapper-to-CLI route
- A3: one valid receipt closes once; repeat closure/replay stays idempotent; no automatic successor
- A4: mini source, generated and selected-installed entry points report identical disposition for these cases; untested Windows recorded as explicitly unverified
- Reuse the receipts in #62; no second corpus or ledger. Stop once the four acceptance cases have receipts (no broad #62/#69 completion, Windows matrix, daemon, Jev integration, model gate or catalog port)

binary.provenance: Source-to-binary build relationship reported in upstream PR; not independently attested by this session.

mini.workingTree: Existing uncommitted corpus/adapter changes plus this qualification runner; commit alone does not identify tested bytes.

corpusPin.rule: vendored verbatim; refresh by copying the directory from the pinned commit and updating this pin; scripts/kbd-phase-closure.conformance.test.mjs fails if any vendored byte differs from a recorded sha256

parity.compared: Exact case IDs, result, every step exit, assertion disposition/phaseStatus/successor, executable path/hash

limits: No Windows/Linux, installed Codex, remote control plane or harness hook activation. Upstream source-to-binary provenance is reported by PR, not independently attested. Initial driver ended at its time limit after three surfaces; only installed surface rerun, aggregate compared saved receipts. All code/receipts remain local; no push/release requested.
